title: The 'Dark Matter Asteroid' That Hit Earth—And No One Detected It
hook: A mountain-sized object made of invisible dark matter slammed into the Pacific in 2014—and we only know because GPS satellites went haywire for 3 minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the familiar threat of asteroid impact with the utterly alien concept of invisible matter—creates immediate 'what if' panic.

title: The 'Star That Stole Its Own Supernova'—A Cosmic Theft
hook: A star destined to explode as a supernova suddenly dimmed and collapsed—its companion star had been siphoning its fuel for millennia, robbing it of a grand death.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personification of a cosmic crime—'star theft' is a shocking, story-driven concept that feels like a sci-fi plot but is real.

title: The Classified 'Doomsday Radar' That Could Trigger an Extinction Event
hook: In the 1980s, the USSR built a radar so powerful that, if switched on, it could have ignited Earth's atmosphere—and it was tested twice.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden superweapon that nearly ended the world—classic 'secret government' thriller with existential stakes.

title: The 'Silent Supernova' That Vaporized a Star Without a Flash
hook: In 2019, a massive star in the Triangulum Galaxy vanished in months—no explosion, no light, just a faint neutrino pulse that said it had become a black hole instantly.
why_this_can_go_viral: The uncanny idea of a star dying 'silently' challenges our understanding of cosmic violence—mystery draws viewers in.

title: The 'Gamma Ray Burst Clock'—Earth Was Nearly Sterilized in 2004
hook: A gamma ray burst from 50,000 light-years away missed us by a hair in 2004—if it had been pointed 10 degrees closer, Earth's ozone layer would have burned off.
why_this_can_go_viral: Specific near-disaster event with vivid 'what if' imagery—viewers love thinking about how close we came to annihilation.

title: The 'Dark Matter Pulse' That Kills Electronics—And It's Due Tomorrow
hook: Every 12 years, a wave of dark matter passes through Earth that has been linked to mass electronics failures—the next pulse is predicted for next month.
why_this_can_go_viral: Imminent timing creates urgency—viewers will share because they fear the event might actually happen.

title: The 'Alien Signal' That Was Just a Microwave Oven—Until It Wasn't
hook: For decades, the 'Wow! Signal' was dismissed as a microwave oven, but new analysis shows it came from a star system with an Earth-like exoplanet—and it's pulsing again.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reopens a famous mystery with new evidence—hook of 'we were wrong' drives curiosity and debate.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Vaccine'—What If We're Already in a Simulation?
hook: A physicist calculated that if we're in a simulation, the reason we see no aliens is because our creators rebooted the universe after a previous civilization reached singularity.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines simulation theory with Fermi paradox—a mind-bending twist that sparks endless commentary and shares.

title: The 'Classified Space Mine' That Harvested Asteroids for Nuclear Weapons
hook: Declassified CIA documents reveal a secret 1970s program to capture an asteroid and extract uranium for space-based nukes—the mission was called 'Project Trenchcoat'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Declassified secrets + space weapons + Cold War paranoia = perfect storm for viral conspiracy and true-crime-in-space content.

title: The 'Black Hole Star' That Shouldn't Exist—It's Eating Its Own Core
hook: Astronomers found a star orbiting so close to a black hole that its outer layers are being siphoned off, yet it survives—and it's been doing this for 10 million years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Impossible survival story—viewers root for the 'zombie star' while being horrified by its plight.

title: The 'Invisible Comet' That Hit Earth 12,000 Years Ago—And Triggered a Mini Ice Age
hook: A comet made of pure carbon—invisible to telescopes—slammed into Greenland, causing the Younger Dryas cooling period. We only found the crater in 2023.
why_this_can_go_viral: Recent discovery adds freshness—the idea of an 'invisible' world-ending event is deeply unsettling and shareable.

title: The 'Dark Matter Whisper' That Physicists Can't Explain—And It's Getting Louder
hook: A mysterious signal from a German dark matter detector has been pulsing for 7 years—it doesn't match any known particle, and it's increasing in amplitude.
why_this_can_go_viral: Real ongoing mystery with 'getting louder' cliffhanger—creates narrative tension perfect for short-form video.

title: The 'Alien Megastructure' Star—We Now Know It's Not a Swarm of Comets
hook: Tabby's Star still dims unpredictably—new infrared data shows it's surrounded by a solid ring of something 1000x larger than any known structure.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reopens the most famous alien megastructure mystery with fresh data—excites both skeptics and believers.

title: The 'Classified Orbital Laser' That Could Boil Oceans—And It's Still Up There
hook: A declassified Soviet laser satellite from 1987 remains in orbit, functional, and its targeting system could fry a city's power grid if activated by the wrong signal.
why_this_can_go_viral: Lingering Cold War threat that could still cause chaos—'it's still up there' is a perfect fear hook.

title: The 'Gamma Ray Burst That Wakes Up Every 100 Million Years'—And It's Aimed at Us
hook: A star system 8000 light-years away fires a gamma ray burst toward Earth like clockwork every 100 million years—and we're 20 million years overdue for the next one.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combine periodic cosmic threat with 'overdue' timing—creates panic-inducing countdown that drives shares.

title: The 'Signal That Was Aliens Asking for Help'—And We Ignored It
hook: A 1977 signal from Proxima Centauri was a repeating pattern of prime numbers followed by a distress code—SETI dismissed it as interference because it was 'too perfect'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reversal of expectation—we are the ones who ignored a cry for help—moral outrage drives engagement.

title: The 'Classified Nuclear Rocket' That Went Critical in Orbit—And Never Burned Out
hook: In 1965, the US secretly launched a nuclear thermal rocket that malfunctioned, spewing radioactive debris into low Earth orbit—it's still circling us every 90 minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ongoing danger from a secret Cold War experiment—'it's still up there' is a powerful, shareable fear.
